id: title:Gilbert09:sync customers subscriptions and merchant accounts

review.posthog_relevance: Adds GraphQL query construction and timestamp normalization for Braintree warehouse ingestion, supporting customer and recurring billing subscription data ingestion.
review.reason: The chunk includes implementation changes in P1.F2.H3 that construct GraphQL queries and normalize nested timestamps for Braintree warehouse ingestion, representing a substantive capability improvement. P1.F1.H1 is documentation only, and P1.F5 hunks are test-only, not production implementation. The tier is assigned based on the implementation hunk P1.F2.H3.
review.uncertainty: The chunk also includes documentation and test-only changes; tier assignment relies solely on the implementation hunk. No tier assignment is made for the documentation or test hunks.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a documentation and implementation update for Braintree warehouse ingestion. P1.F1.H1 is documentation only; P1.F2.H1–P1.F5.H5 implement query construction, node normalization, and endpoint configuration. No tier assignment is made here; scoring is deferred to the complete group review.

observations.behavior: Documentation update: checklist items marked, no code change.
